p: Stretches a linear colour image with Lupton RGB, a root-power stretch or PhotometricStretch, with a live preview; the result opens as a new image window. No network connections, no external programs, no files written. Installing this version removes the files of products no longer distributed from this repository, where present: EZ Donut Repair (src/scripts/scarter4work/EZDonutRepair.js and .xsgn), PI Copilot (bin/PICopilot-pxm.so and .xsgn, doc/tools/PICopilot/) and Gaia Depth Grade (src/scripts/GaiaDepthGrade/, doc/scripts/GaiaDepthGrade/, bin/gaia-depth-grade-sidecar). The stretch itself is unchanged. Documentation: doc/scripts/EZStretch/EZStretch.html.
